remove_top._sqlite3.pyd: No application or bundled tool imports sqlite3 or uses a database; recorded tests do not load it.
remove_top.sqlite3.dll: Only _sqlite3.pyd needs this DLL; removed together after checking the module/DLL trace.

stdlib: Keep every entry. Dynamic codecs, subprocess, multiprocessing and the shipped analysis tools prevent a smaller proved closure.
pillow: Keep all plugins and extension modules. Image.open accepts user-chosen formats; TrueType fonts are used by tiledisc and tools.
ssl: Keep _ssl, libssl and libcrypto. Standard-library urllib is shipped and HTTPS/hashed data support has no complete negative reachability proof.
